1981-2415-8249-8319.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-8249-8319.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-1849-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2813-4740-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2813-4740-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
There's an indestructible artifact on the battlefield.
2813-4740-5220-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

215-5614-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-5614-7297.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4050-5086-5183-6291-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-5086-5183-6291-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater

342-4321-5777-7343.description:
Activate a Food by paying {0} (due to Sam and Mutagen Man) and tapping it.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food token due to Peregrin Took.
Resolve the Food ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

4120-4186-5231-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
4120-4186-5231-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

3197-4120-5256-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
3197-4120-5256-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Herd Baloth, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1687-5686-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5147-5220-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5147-5220-6594.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2511-4452-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2511-4452-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

11-799-6555-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-799-6555-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and returning the original Karn's Temporal Sundering to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Karn's Temporal Sundering from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

436-1430-5220.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Mirror Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirror Image dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mirror Image from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Mirror Image onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

317-4708-5660.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dark Sphere ability.
Repeat.

339-677-2034-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

147-997-3890.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
147-997-3890.description:
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}. 
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

585-3767-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
585-3767-3918-5527.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1645-4826-5954-6751.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

813-1922-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Blur.
813-1922-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2816-6410.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Howlsquad Heavy.
2816-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
2816-6410.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-1740-1749-3556-4074.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Chandra's ability this turn.
1031-1740-1749-3556-4074.description:
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Arcavios.
Invasion of Arcavios triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Invocation of the Founders.
Activate Chandra's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Invocation of the Founders.
Chandra and Invocation of the Founders trigger, copying Flicker twice, with one copy targeting Chandra and the other targeting Extraction Specialist.
Resolve the first Flicker copy, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the second Flicker copy, blinking Extraction Specialist.
When Extraction Specialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Hexmage to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Invocation of the Founders, causing it to enter the battlefield as Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2060-2747-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Aragorn and Arwen.
When Aragorn and Arwen enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control and gain 1 life for each other creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5069-5080.notablePrerequisites: Each opponent has a life total that is less than or equal to half their library size, rounded up.
5069-5080.description:
Activate Duskmantle Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{U}{B}.
Cast Maddening Cacophony with kicker by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Duskmantle Guildmage triggers for each card milled this way.
Resolve the first Duskmantle Guildmage trigger, causing the opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining trigger.

338-1874-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Scurry Oak.
You have a way to gain life.
338-1874-4186.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak equal to the amount of life gained.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Ajani's Welcome, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2744-2808-3734.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {3}{U/P}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Enduring Scalelord.
Phyrexian Metamorph enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Enduring Scalelord and Phyrexian Metamorph triggers.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Enduring Scalelord triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 4.
